rollups.text: Professional networking from scratch: On 2024-03-15, James Perez said he was starting to build a professional network, had sent two LinkedIn messages, and wanted broader knowledge and potential collaborations. He set a goal of at least 50 new contacts within six months, by about 2024-09-15, and considered events, LinkedIn, professional associations, online forums, and introductions. By 2024-03-14 he had completed 2 of 5 planned LinkedIn messages to potential mentors; on 2024-04-05 he reported completing 4 of 6 planned outreach messages for that week and feeling motivated. On 2024-04-25, he reported 18 new contacts at the Istanbul Psychology Symposium, exceeding his stated 15-contact goal by 20%. Elapsed time from the initial goal to the symposium result: about 36 days.

Istanbul Psychology Symposium: James Perez planned to attend the 2024-04-20 symposium and, by 2024-04-05, had booked a $45 bus ticket for 2024-04-19 and was preparing a trauma-therapy-outcomes presentation due 2024-04-18. He aimed to collect 15 business cards and later also discussed a goal of 20. On 2024-04-20, he presented, met Dr. Elif Kaya, discussed trauma-therapy outcomes, collected 18 business cards, and met five new contacts at the symposium dinner with Omar. On 2024-04-25, he reported 18 new professional contacts and planned follow-up with Dr. Kaya and other contacts. From booking/planning on 2024-04-05 to the symposium: 15 days; follow-up planning was recorded five days after the event.

Symposium networking targets and outcomes changed: on 2024-04-05, James Perez said he aimed to collect 15 business cards; a later record that day gives a target of 20. At the 2024-04-20 Istanbul Psychology Symposium, he collected 18 cards, exceeding the 15-card goal by 3 (20%) but falling 2 short of the 20-card target. On 2024-04-25, he reported 18 new contacts and explicitly described this as 20% above his 15-contact goal.

Trauma-therapy presentation and elevator pitch: On 2024-04-05, James Perez had drafted a 10-slide presentation on trauma-therapy outcomes, due 2024-04-18, and was practicing his elevator pitch daily with a goal of delivering it in 90 seconds by 2024-04-15. He sought help making the talk engaging and timing the pitch. By 2024-04-22, he reported reducing the pitch to 85 seconds; on 2024-04-25, he requested further refinements while keeping it within 85 seconds. The pitch improved by 5 seconds against the original 90-second target over about 17 days.

Telepsychology expansion: On 2024-03-15, James Perez was considering expanding his clinical psychology practice into telepsychology, with a possible decision or launch targeted by Q3 2024. He asked about using his network, helping clients transition, and preparing for technology, privacy, regulatory, billing, training, marketing, and engagement challenges. On 2024-04-25, he had a plan to pilot telepsychology sessions beginning 2024-06-01, targeting 10 clients during June. The records establish a progression from considering expansion to planning a June pilot, but do not confirm that the pilot began or that the target was reached.

Omar mentorship and professional relationship: James Perez and Omar had been friends since meeting at the Istanbul Psychology Conference in 2004. On 2024-03-15, James planned to ask Omar for LinkedIn introductions and explore joint work; a later record states Omar would mentor James beginning 2024-04-01. On 2024-04-05, James planned periodic check-ins, a possible joint trauma-therapy webinar, introductions for Omar, and a congratulatory note about Omar’s publication. James had dinner with Omar at Deniz Restaurant on 2024-04-23 to discuss mentorship progress, trauma-therapy work, a project, areas for improvement, and research. On 2024-04-25, James planned a thank-you email and proposed a follow-up meeting for 2024-05-07; that appointment was suggested, not confirmed. Elapsed time from the planned mentorship start to the dinner: 22 days.

Turkish Psychological Association: James Perez was considering joining the Turkish Psychological Association by 2024-03-30, and on 2024-04-24 he joined, paying an annual fee of $150. Melinda recommended a virtual meeting scheduled for 2024-05-05 and offered to introduce him to the association president. On 2024-04-25, James planned to research the association and president, prepare an introduction and questions, review research and association news, test his technology, and follow up after the meeting. The records establish membership and preparation, but not whether he attended the meeting or made the introduction.
rollups.topic: Turkish Psychological Association membership and meeting

rollups.text: Networking with Dr. Elif Kaya: Jason shared Dr. Kaya’s contact information with James Perez after they met on 2024-03-28; by 2024-04-05, Jason had introduced them. James planned a coffee meeting with Dr. Kaya for 2024-04-21 and prepared questions about prolonged exposure with CBT, virtual reality, and EMDR research. They met at the Istanbul Psychology Symposium on 2024-04-20 and discussed trauma-therapy outcomes. On 2024-04-25, James planned an email referencing their discussion, a verified article link, and possible research collaboration; he said he would double-check the link and send it. The records do not confirm that the email was sent or that a collaboration began.

Co-authorship with Russell: James Perez met Russell at a webinar on 2024-03-30 and exchanged LinkedIn profiles. On 2024-04-25, James said he had accepted Russell’s offer to co-author an article for $300 instead of taking a $500 paid speaking engagement scheduled for 2024-05-12; he was unsure whether he had made the right choice. The article deadline was 2024-06-15. The records document acceptance and deadline, but do not establish completion or publication.

Networking event with Carolyn: On 2024-04-05, James Perez said Carolyn had invited him to co-host a local networking event scheduled for 2024-05-10; the records do not confirm that he accepted the invitation. By 2024-04-25, he had committed to attending an event on that date and had created a five-point agenda. The event was scheduled for 6:00–9:00 PM at the North Ericshire Community Center, with a $20 refreshments budget. A detailed agenda was proposed, but the records do not confirm the final program or that the event took place.

Professional events James Perez attended or planned to attend: clinical psychology innovations workshop, attended alone on 2024-03-10; Istanbul Psychology Symposium, planned for 2024-04-20 and later reported as attended, with presentation and networking outcomes; Turkish Psychological Association virtual meeting, scheduled for 2024-05-05, attendance not confirmed; local networking event at North Ericshire Community Center, scheduled for 2024-05-10, attendance not confirmed; local mental health awareness speaking event, scheduled for 2024-05-22, attendance not confirmed.
entities: North Ericshire Community Center networking event

rollups.text: Professional contacts and collaborators with dated interactions: Omar, long-standing friend and later mentor, friendship began in 2004; Carolyn, colleague at North Ericshire Mental Health Clinic since 2015; Bruce, met at a workshop by 2024-03-15; Jason, met on 2024-03-28; Russell, met at a webinar on 2024-03-30; Dr. Elif Kaya, introduced through Jason by 2024-04-05 and met at the symposium on 2024-04-20; Melinda, recommended the Turkish Psychological Association virtual meeting and offered an introduction to its president by 2024-04-25.

Networking anxiety and meditation changed over time: on 2024-03-15, James Perez reported mindfulness meditation three times per week and asked whether it could help with networking anxiety. On 2024-04-05, he said he had increased practice to four sessions per week and considered increasing to five because he felt overwhelmed by pre-event anxiety. No later frequency or outcome is recorded.

Digital-networking course: On 2024-03-15, James Perez was enrolled in a 12-week online course on digital networking tools, scheduled to start 2024-03-25. He sought advice on balancing it with work and applying its skills to his clinical psychology career. The records confirm enrollment and the planned start, but do not state whether he completed the course.

Professional-development budget figures changed across discussions: on 2024-03-15, James Perez cited an annual budget of $1,200 and agreed to a proposed allocation of $600 for high-impact events, $300 for courses and certifications, $200 for local events, and $100 as an emergency fund. Later on 2024-03-15, he also cited a $1,500 professional-development budget. On 2024-04-05, he said he had spent $1,000 of a $1,200 budget and had $200 remaining; he considered reserving or splitting that remainder between a May event and meditation, with no final allocation recorded.

James Perez’s networking time and limits varied across records: on 2024-04-25, he reported balancing 12 clinical hours and 8 networking hours per week, using social media one hour per day, and taking daily 30-minute walks after work. He was concerned he might be overdoing networking, and Nancy suggested limiting symposium networking to four hours daily. No adopted revised schedule is recorded.

Professional-development and networking expenses or commitments recorded: $1,200 annual development budget reported 2024-03-15; $1,500 budget also reported 2024-03-15; $500 Istanbul event ticket under consideration on 2024-03-15; $150 bus-travel budget for the symposium reported 2024-03-15; $45 round-trip bus ticket booked 2024-04-25 for follow-up meetings; $200 allocated for symposium meals and materials on 2024-04-05, of which $180 was spent on 2024-04-20, leaving $20; $150 annual Turkish Psychological Association fee paid 2024-04-24; $120 Trauma Therapy Journal subscription reported 2024-04-05.

James Perez’s LinkedIn networking goal unfolded as follows: on 2024-03-15 he began tracking new connections toward a goal of 50 by the end of September 2024; by 2024-04-25 he had added 25 and had 25 remaining. Elapsed time from the stated start date to the progress update: 41 days. No later completion or revised outcome is recorded.

James Perez’s professional event activity and follow-up included: attending the Istanbul Psychology Symposium on 2024-04-20 and collecting 18 business cards; co-hosting a North Ericshire networking event with Carolyn on 2024-05-10, described as successful, with 35 attendees, five collaborations initiated, and four positive feedback emails; planning attendee follow-up and a satisfaction survey on 2024-05-12; and attending a networking lunch with mentor Omar at Mavi Balik Restaurant on 2024-06-15, where Omar introduced him to Dr. Selin Yilmaz and James received three telepsychology referrals. Elapsed time from the symposium to the lunch: 56 days; from the May event to the lunch: 36 days.

James Perez’s trauma-therapy webinar developed from preparation to reported results: by 2024-05-12 he had prepared a 45-minute script, revised slides after Omar’s feedback, and planned an interactive Q&A; the webinar was scheduled for 2024-05-15. Later records report 120 live attendees, 85% positive feedback on the trauma-therapy content, and that the $250 webinar-software expense was considered worthwhile. The software cost was first discussed on 2024-05-12; the elapsed time from preparation to the scheduled webinar was three days.

James Perez’s telepsychology pilot progressed from planning to launch and professional follow-up: Omar reviewed the plan on 2024-05-30; James launched the pilot on 2024-06-01 with 45-minute sessions priced at $80 and a goal of 10 clients by month-end; he planned a check-in with his first three clients on 2024-06-05; and he later reported three referrals from the 2024-06-15 networking lunch. On 2024-06-22, a Zoom call with Dr. Selin Yilmaz was scheduled to discuss research collaboration. The elapsed time from plan review to launch was two days, and from launch to the scheduled collaboration call was 21 days. One 2024-06-01 record also says James had never conducted a telepsychology session, so the pilot’s launch and session status are not fully consistent across records.

James Perez and Russell’s article collaboration developed across several records: on 2024-05-12 they had agreed to submit an article to the Journal of Clinical Psychology by 2024-06-10, with a suggested staged drafting and revision schedule; on 2024-05-12 James also considered using Google Docs for a trauma-therapy article, without confirming that choice. By July 2024, Russell had agreed to review James’s telepsychology pilot data, and James planned to incorporate Russell’s feedback and submit an article that month. The July pilot-data article is not clearly established as the same article as the earlier Journal of Clinical Psychology submission.

James Perez’s virtual-event participation goal was stated on 2024-05-12 as a 30% increase over the following three months, through approximately 2024-08-12. On 2024-06-01 he reiterated a 30% increase goal, this time with a target period through approximately 2024-09-01. The end date therefore shifted about 20 days later; no measured result is recorded.

James Perez reported 25 new LinkedIn connections toward his goal of 50 as of 2024-04-25, leaving 25 to go. He reported meeting seven new professionals at a symposium dinner on 2024-04-20, and separately reported meeting 10 new professionals at an event on 2024-05-10, including three university researchers. These are distinct reported networking counts; the records do not establish whether any individuals overlapped.

James Perez’s professional-development budget records show $1,700 spent of $1,800 on 2024-05-12 and again on 2024-06-01, leaving $100; on 2024-06-20 he reported $1,750 spent and $50 remaining. This is a reported increase of $50 in spending between the June 1 and June 20 records. Separately, he reported spending $200 on catering for the 2024-05-10 event, $50 over the initial $150 catering budget; that catering amount is not necessarily part of the same budget total.

James Perez reported reducing weekend work by 50% by 2024-05-12 and confirmed that reduction again on 2024-06-01. These are two records of the same reported change, not evidence of two separate reductions; no later change is recorded.

James Perez enabled two-factor authentication on at least one account on 2024-05-07 and asked on 2024-05-12 how to enable it on all professional social-media accounts. By 2024-06-01, he reported that two-factor authentication was enabled on all his professional social-media accounts. Elapsed time from the initial reported enablement to the all-accounts status: 25 days.

Professional-development courses and training James Perez reported completing or scoring: a 12-week digital networking course, completed with a 92% final score, reported on 2024-05-12 and again on 2024-06-01; telehealth-platform training with a 95% proficiency score on 2024-05-28. The repeated digital-networking score is one reported achievement, not two separate course completions.

Reported recurring professional relationships relevant to James Perez’s networking and work: Omar was his professional mentor, referenced by 2024-05-12 and again in June 2024; Carolyn was his colleague and event co-host, referenced in May and June 2024; Nancy was identified as his romantic partner on 2024-06-01 and was also involved in helping manage his telepsychology calendar; Jason was a professional contact who referred clients to the pilot, with two clients mentioned in a 2024-06-01 record; Russell was a collaborator on article work, discussed in May and July 2024; Melinda introduced James to an association president at a virtual meeting on 2024-05-05 and later invited him to present pilot results at a meeting on 2024-07-20; Omar introduced James to Dr. Selin Yilmaz at the 2024-06-15 lunch.

James Perez’s reported telepsychology-related client and audience outcomes include 120 live webinar attendees on 2024-05-12, five positive online reviews during June 2024 in one record, and three telepsychology referrals received at the 2024-06-15 networking lunch. The 120-attendee figure is also repeated in another record; it represents one webinar audience, not two events.

Professional events James Perez planned or was invited to attend or present at: Istanbul Psychology Symposium, attended 2024-04-20; North Ericshire networking event, co-hosted 2024-05-10; European Psychological Association virtual telepsychology conference, scheduled 2024-06-12; virtual networking event, planned for 2024-06-25; Istanbul Trauma Therapy Research Group meeting, for which he was invited on 2024-07-01; Turkish Psychological Association meeting and telepsychology pilot presentation in Ankara, scheduled for 2024-07-20. The record set does not confirm that he attended every planned or invited event.

James Perez’s Ankara conference and follow-up, July 2024: By July 10, 2024, he had chosen to present his telepsychology pilot in person at the Ankara conference on July 20, 2024, rather than attend a paid workshop; he prepared and booked a hotel for July 19, then planned to fly from North Ericshire to Ankara on July 18. On July 20, he presented and later reported that 10 professionals requested meetings; another account reported 12 follow-up meeting requests and positive feedback. On August 5, he planned personalized follow-up emails to the 10 professionals. On August 25, he said there were 12 requests and wanted to prioritize meetings within two weeks of the event. Elapsed time: 10 days from the July 10 preparations to the presentation, 16 days from the presentation to the planned August 5 follow-up, and 36 days from presentation to the August 25 scheduling question. The reported request counts differ across records.

James Perez’s research-paper collaboration with Dr. Selin Yilmaz: On July 10, 2024, James said Dr. Yilmaz had invited him to co-author a paper, and he decided to accept; the stated deadline was August 30. He planned to follow up after their July 1 Istanbul Trauma Therapy Research Group meeting and suggest a call, but no response or call was confirmed. By August 25, an outline meeting with Dr. Yilmaz was planned for that day, and a joint paper submission to the European Journal of Clinical Psychology was planned for September 15. James finalized a research-paper draft with Dr. Yilmaz on September 18 and submitted his research paper to that journal on September 20. Elapsed time: 70 days from the July 10 invitation/decision to the September 18 finalized draft, and 2 days from finalizing the draft to submission. The records do not establish that the August 30 deadline and September 15 planned deadline refer to the same paper deadline.

James Perez’s August 10, 2024 webinar with Jason and Russell: On July 15, James had a Zoom call scheduled with Jason and Russell to finalize webinar content, and he said they had agreed to co-present. On August 10, James co-presented a webinar with them and reported receiving three invitations for future collaborations; he also reported that 90% of 130 attendees rated the content excellent. On August 25, he planned to thank Jason and Russell, discuss the invitations, and arrange a meeting. Elapsed time: 26 days from the scheduled July 15 planning call to the webinar, and 15 days from the webinar to the planned follow-up.

James Perez’s September 5, 2024 virtual networking event with Melinda: By August 5, James was preparing to co-host the event with Melinda; on September 5, he co-hosted it and described it as successful. He later reported that 50 professionals attended and that he secured four new research collaborators. On September 20, he sought advice about following up and expanding his network. Elapsed time: 31 days from the August 5 preparation to the event, and 15 days from the event to the follow-up discussion.
rollups.topic: virtual networking event and new collaborators

rollups.text: James Perez’s telepsychology work and reported client-base growth: James described a June 2024 pilot launch. On August 5, he reported that his client base had grown 35% since the launch. On September 20, he reported 10 new client referrals in September and a 40% increase in his telepsychology client base. Elapsed time: about two months from the June launch to the first reported growth, followed by about six weeks to the September report. The records do not establish whether the 35% and 40% figures use the same baseline or measurement method.

Professional courses and scores reported by James Perez: Advanced public speaking course, completed July 5, 2024, with an 88% score (reported in multiple records); another account reported a 92% score for an Advanced Public Speaking course on July 10, 2024, while James also said he had never attended public-speaking or professional-development courses, so the course history and score conflict. Advanced research writing course, reported completed by August 25, 2024, with a 90% score.

Reported professional-development budgets and balances for James Perez: July 10, 2024: $1,850 spent from $1,900, leaving $50. August 5, 2024: $2,000 spent from $2,100, leaving $100. August 25, 2024: he again reported $2,000 spent from $2,100, leaving $100. September 20, 2024: he reported $2,300 spent from $2,400, leaving $100. These are dated reported figures; the records do not explain the budget increases.

James Perez’s reported weekly work-hour figures changed across records: July 10, 2024, 20 clinical hours and 15 networking hours; August 5, 2024, 18 clinical and 18 networking hours; August 25, 2024, 15 clinical and 20 networking hours. On August 5 he also reported recently reducing weekend work by 60%; on August 25 he reported recently reducing it by 70%. These are successive reports, not a confirmed consistent schedule.
rollups.topic: weekly work hours and weekend-work reduction

rollups.text: Reported client feedback and testimonials for James Perez: Seven telepsychology client reviews were mentioned for June 2024, although James also said he had never received feedback or reviews for those services; no review contents were supplied. Separately, James reported seven new positive client testimonials in July 2024, repeated in August records. The June and July reports are distinct, and the June statements conflict.

James Perez reported receiving three telepsychology referrals after Omar introduced him to Dr. Selin Yilmaz at a networking lunch on June 15, 2024. Separately, James reported receiving 10 new client referrals in September 2024. The records do not establish whether any September referrals came from the earlier contacts.

Wellness activities reported by James Perez: He scheduled a massage therapy session for July 11, 2024, to reduce tension before a conference. On August 5, he reported increasing meditation to six sessions per week and said he was still stressed. He reported practicing yoga four times a week since September 1, 2024. The massage was scheduled, not confirmed as attended; meditation and yoga were reported as practices.

James Perez’s professional-development events and travel reported or planned in 2024: Ankara conference presentation, July 20 (hotel booked for July 19; flight booked for July 18); Turkish Psychological Association webinar, August 10 (registration reported); telepsychology ethics workshop in Istanbul, August 30 (planned attendance and $200 fee discussed, but attendance not confirmed); virtual networking event co-hosted with Melinda, September 5 (reported as held); Istanbul summit and clinical innovation workshop, October 10 (registration for the workshop and attendance at the summit were discussed; participation details are not established).

James Perez’s telepsychology employment decisions: On July 10, 2024, he discussed a part-time contract paying $1,200 per month, scheduled to start August 1; on August 1, he said he had accepted it. Separately, on August 5 he considered a full-time telepsychology role paying $3,000 per month with an August 20 decision deadline. On August 25, he said he had accepted that full-time role, scheduled to start September 1. Elapsed time: 26 days between the part-time contract discussion and its scheduled start; 20 days between the August 5 full-time offer discussion and its reported acceptance. The records do not clarify whether the full-time role replaced or overlapped with the part-time contract.

James Perez’s Istanbul summit plans developed from preparation on 2024-09-20 to a planned presentation of research findings and attendance on 2024-10-10; his flight was scheduled for 2024-10-09. On 2024-10-10, he also planned a joint clinical-innovation panel with Jason and Russell. He considered arranging a follow-up with them soon after the summit, but no date or agreement was reported by 2024-10-24. The elapsed time from initial preparation to the summit was 20 days; the proposed follow-up remained undecided 14 days after the summit.

On 2024-09-20, James Perez was managing a telepsychology contract extension and weighing it against preparation for and attendance at the Istanbul summit, including the demands of his regular client schedule. The extension was described as paying $3,500 per month and scheduled to start on 2024-11-01; he was evaluating its terms, with no decision or negotiated outcome reported. The time from the initial balancing concern to the scheduled contract start was 42 days.

On 2024-09-18, James Perez finalized and submitted a research-paper draft to the European Journal of Clinical Psychology. On 2024-09-20, he asked how to use that submission experience to develop his clinical psychology skills and knowledge. No reviewer feedback or publication decision is established; the elapsed time from submission to his question was 2 days.
rollups.topic: Research paper submission and professional development

rollups.text: On 2024-09-20, James Perez said he and Nancy had agreed that he would not check or send work emails after 6 PM during 2024-10-09 through 2024-10-11. He also asked hypothetically how to handle an urgent work matter during that window; no urgent matter or response plan was reported. The agreement covered 3 days, beginning 19 days after it was reported.

James Perez reported receiving 3 telepsychology referrals following Omar’s introduction to Dr. Selin Yilmaz at a networking lunch on 2024-06-15, and 12 client referrals in September 2024. These reported figures total 15 referrals across the two periods; no August figure is established.
